name: Bountiful Harvest raises Reap and Murder damage by 25% (#3073)
contract: Bountiful Harvest 706576 (Spell.dbc: single Apply Aura effect, EffectApplyAuraName 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, EffectBasePoints 24 (+1 display = 25), EffectSpellClassMask[1] 65 = (1<<0)|(1<<6)) reads 'Increases the damage of Reap and Murder by $s1%.' Reap 500357 has native SpellFamilyFlags[1] 1 (bit 0) and Murder 500376 has SpellFamilyFlags[1] 64 (bit 6), both family 36, exactly matching the aura's class mask, so the native generic SpellMod system (AuraEffect::CalculateSpellMod, SPELLMOD_DAMAGE) applies the +25% with no CoA script needed. The spell_modifier metric applies the player's native spell modifiers for a given SpellModOp directly, so it is used here instead of a live damage roll.

steps.label: CONTROL Reap has no damage modifier before the talent
CONTROL Murder has no damage modifier before the talent
REGRESSION Reap gains a 25% damage modifier
REGRESSION Murder gains a 25% damage modifier
